Prior experience working in student advising, academic department support, or higher education administration.
Serve as the primary point of contact for in-person student traffic, greeting visitors, answering routine questions, and providing assistance with standard forms and requests.
Triage complex advising or administrative issues, directing students to appropriate advisors or supervisors when elevated support is required.
Complete daily on-site office procedures, recordkeeping, and associated administrative work to ensure smooth front-desk operations.
Collaborate closely with team members under supervisor oversight to support peak advising periods and routine office workflow.
Proficiency with standard office software and web-based applications, including Microsoft Office suite and email systems.
Previous background in human resources, front-desk coordination, or high-volume customer-facing roles.
Strong customer service, communication, and organizational skills, with a proven ability to interact effectively with students in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with university-specific administrative databases, student record systems, and referral protocols.
Ability to work independently, manage multiple walk-ins or inquiries, and exercise sound judgment on when to escalate issues.
Ability to read, write, and follow written and oral instructions in English.
